contracts: propsys.h is the local Vista 7 SDK shim for the IPropertyStore ABI
taskbar.c owns the Sandboxie wrapper returned from SHGetPropertyStoreForWindow
IPropertyStore inherits from IUnknown so the wrapper must support IID_IUnknown and IID_IPropertyStore
QueryInterface must reject a null output pointer with E_POINTER before writing through it
Unsupported IIDs must set ppv output to NULL and return E_NOINTERFACE
Successful queries must publish the supported interface pointer and then AddRef it

The fix does not change AppUserModelID rewriting, relaunch property rewriting, property forwarding, real property store lifetime forwarding, hook install conditions, or SHGetPropertyStoreForWindow pass through behavior for unsupported requested interfaces
runtime_gate: Windows DLL build plus taskbar property store wrapper and QueryInterface ABI smokes.
